SELECT delivery_seq.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO delivery ( d_no, u_no, r_no, d_addr, d_stats, d_reg_date, d_lat, d_lng ) VALUES ( #{d_no}, #{u_no}, #{r_no}, #{d_addr}, #{d_stats}, SYSDATE, #{d_lat, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{d_lng, jdbcType=DOUBLE} )
mapper.select: SELECT dm.dvm_no, dm.dvm_count, dm.dvm_price, dm.d_no, dm.mn_no, m.mn_name, m.mn_content, m.mn_img FROM dv_menu dm JOIN menu m ON dm.mn_no = m.mn_no WHERE dm.d_no = #{d_no}
SELECT d_no, d_addr, d_lat, d_lng, d_cooking_time, d_delivery_time, d_arrival_time, d_stats, d_reg_date, r_no, u_no FROM delivery WHERE r_no = #{r_no} ORDER BY d_reg_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery SET d_stats = '주문승인', d_cooking_time = #{d_cooking_time}, d_delivery_time = #{d_delivery_time}, d_arrival_time = #{d_arrival_time} WHERE d_no = #{d_no}
mapper.select: SELECT d_no, d_addr, d_lat, d_lng, d_cooking_time, d_delivery_time, d_arrival_time, d_stats, d_reg_date, r_no, u_no FROM delivery WHERE d_no = #{d_no}

SELECT d.d_no, d.d_addr, d.d_lat, d.d_lng, d.d_cooking_time, d.d_delivery_time, d.d_arrival_time, d.d_stats, d.d_reg_date, d.r_no, d.u_no, r.r_name FROM delivery d JOIN restaurant r ON d.r_no = r.r_no WHERE d.u_no = #{u_no} ORDER BY d.d_reg_date DESC

SELECT d.d_no, d.d_addr, d.d_lat, d.d_lng, d.d_cooking_time, d.d_delivery_time, d.d_arrival_time, d.d_stats, d.d_reg_date, d.r_no, d.u_no, r.r_name, u.u_name FROM delivery d JOIN restaurant r ON d.r_no = r.r_no JOIN users u ON d.u_no = u.u_no ORDER BY d.d_no DESC

SELECT h.hour_slot AS "DELIVERY_HOUR", NVL(ROUND(AVG((d.d_arrival_time - d.d_reg_date) * 24 * 60)), h.default_time) AS "AVG_MINUTES" FROM ( SELECT '11시' AS hour_slot, 25 AS default_time FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '12시' AS hour_slot, 42 AS default_time FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '13시' AS hour_slot, 32 AS default_time FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '15시' AS hour_slot, 26 AS default_time FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '17시' AS hour_slot, 30 AS default_time FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '18시' AS hour_slot, 48 AS default_time FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '19시' AS hour_slot, 52 AS default_time FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '20시' AS hour_slot, 38 AS default_time FROM DUAL ) h LEFT JOIN delivery d ON TO_CHAR(d.d_reg_date, 'HH24') = REPLACE(h.hour_slot, '시', '') AND d.d_stats = '배달완료' AND d.d_arrival_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.hour_slot, h.default_time ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(h.hour_slot, '시', ''))
